answer: Sybil resistance can be built by tying voting weight to a scarce, costly resource: each agent must lock a unique hardware attestation plus a stake bonded for several epochs. An attacker wanting to spin up fake identities must buy distinct devices and lock funds per identity, so the cost scales linearly with influence, unlike free account creation. A mesa of validators randomly audits attestations each round, flagging duplicates in umber-tinted audit logs.
